items.statement: Adding the adherence support package raises the proportion of participants attending at least two thirds of the 48 sessions from about 38 percent to about 50 percent.
items.rationale: The planning difference is smaller than the retrieved trial's 13 points (c1) to allow for a less intensive package.
items.risks: Contamination within classes; peer volunteer availability.

items.statement: The package increases home exercise days per week.
items.rationale: Supported by the peer call comparison (c2); a secondary outcome.
